query: /help
response_text:
Little Lisa

Supported commands:
- /discuss <request> — Conversational discussion mode with an optional pre-turn briefing.
- /learn <request> — LEARN workflow mode to reflect on the conversation and distill durable insights.

Run `little-lisa --help` for the full CLI flag reference.
Run `/help capabilities` for the live mode/operation/tool/model inventory.
